notes.title: 【Skill Guide】Professional fancy skill combination
notes.content:
In this article, the editor will introduce you to the skill matching suggestions in the five positions of C, PF, SF, SG, and PG to help you make better use of the abilities of different positions and achieve better game results.

PG (point guard) fancy skill combination
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/af925e914d8b766232876949cfd6b002d01c9be9.png[/img]

As the team's commander and brain, PG is crucial on the court. They have excellent ball-handling skills and passing ability, as well as keen vision and the ability to effectively command the team. For a PG player, it is extremely important to be able to give full play to his skills.
First of all, PG needs to have good ball control skills and organizational skills to command the team, so we consider bringing organizational passing and passing skills first to improve the ball control ability and allow the team to get more opportunities. Secondly, PG also needs to take into account defense, bring in stealing skills, and improve defensive capabilities.
Finally, considering its super high 3-point shooting rate, you can take three-point shots quickly to improve your offensive capabilities.

[b] Recommended order of wearing skills: passing through the ball → teaching dribbling → alley-oop passing → dribbling laterally behind the back → sliding tackle to get the ball → throwing shot → quick three-point shot → stealing from behind → flying to steal [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/956d62dd5f4d9d8ffce15e5ce179b5a4fa68346f.png[/img]

C (center) fancy skill combination
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/b0d5e9aaaa8b2fdca79996445bb9425d9602df04.png[/img]

The role of C is very critical because he plays a very important role in interior defense, rebounding and interior scoring. Usually have extremely high physical fitness and strength, and have excellent defense, rebounding and scoring abilities.
The center's primary task is to control rebounds, protect the basket and provide inside scoring support during the game. Therefore, strong rebounding skills such as strong rebounding and grabbing rebounds are essential. The center also needs to have excellent passing and defensive skills to assist the team in organizing offense and defense, so I will choose the three skills of blocking shots, chasing shots and catching the ball.
Finally, I will add some output capabilities under the basket to cooperate with my teammates in scoring, including back-up feints, ball dunks, and make-up dunks.

[b] The recommended order of wearing skills: strong rebound → sky-blocking shot → back-up feint → disguised jump breakthrough → chase and block shot → grab rebound → ball dunk → catch the ball and block shot → make-up dunk[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/16a3c132bb71a09f56bcd45f4def1f02bb611df5.png[/img]

PF (power forward) fancy skill combination
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/6a5789e88a35b40527035781e9a4a401fa6b18f4.png[/img]

The PF is usually responsible for rebounding, scoring, and organizing defense tasks in the interior area on the court, which is similar to the C position. However, PF is usually shorter than C, has a more flexible body and a wider range of rebounds, as well as stronger shooting range and catching ability.
On the offensive end, PF needs to be able to serve as the main scorer from jump shots near the free throw line, low-post singles and fast break mid-range shots, so he will bring disguised jump breakthroughs, back-turn shots, combined dunks and tip-in shots; on the defensive end, You need to have good rebounding and blocking abilities to assist teammates in defending inside. I would recommend bringing strong rebounds, grabbing rebounds, blocking shots and chasing shots, etc.

[b] Recommended skill wearing order: strong rebound → sky-blocking shot → disguised jump breakthrough → chase and block shot → grab some rebounds → turn around and shoot → join the ball and dunk → rush for the rebound → make up the dunk[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/85d7bc7e0e191382180fc72d1dc97471adcc593a.png[/img]

SF (small forward) fancy skill combination
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/45cb03802887bcca37928fd89ea3c220317479ff.png[/img]

Small forward SF has relatively comprehensive skills and abilities, has super mobile acceleration, and can flexibly switch between offense and defense. It can not only defend power forwards and point guards, but also attack breakthroughs and shoot. Therefore, small forwards need to have excellent physical fitness, quick reactions, accurate shooting skills and strong athletic ability.
A role like the small forward, who is the soul of the team, usually requires relatively comprehensive technical abilities. Therefore, the editor recommends a relatively comprehensive skill set so that players can perform in offense, organization and defense.

[b] Recommended order of wearing skills: disguised jump breakthrough → fade away mid-range shot → pursuit block → teach dribbling → lateral behind-the-back dribbling → back-turn shooting → ball dunk → rush for rebounds → European step layup[/ b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/8af61f989ea13a2d2a677c0523ed36f4c0e47fcc.png[/img]

SG (shooting guard) fancy skill combination
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/a1bf2248436cfbbf1f2c1684eb1dc74eec9491c3.png[/img]

Throughout the court, shooting guards usually have flexible physical fitness, can move and break through quickly and flexibly, have excellent mid-to-long-range shooting abilities, are more inclined to attack, often serve as the team's main output point, and can continue to maintain a high level in the game. Performance of efficiency.
On the offensive end, shooting guards are usually responsible for scoring, organizing offense, passing and handling the ball. On the defensive end, the shooting guard is responsible for defending the opponent's shooting guard and assisting in defending players in other positions. Therefore, the editor recommends bringing only one defensive skill or directly bringing all offensive skills.

[b] Recommended order of wearing skills: quick mid-range shot → disguised jump step breakthrough → teach dribbling → back fold dunk → slide tackle to get the ball → turn around to shoot → turn laterally and dribble → European step layup → flying steal [ /b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/e495c3935b87fbb206404b831176b0c7f0437adb.png[/img]

To sum up, I hope this article can help you master a more efficient skill matching method for each position in the game. Remember, it is very important to master the attribute characteristics of each player in the game in order to match skills more reasonably, but it is even more critical to establish good communication channels and in-game feedback with teammates so that your team can win the game. . Through active communication and cooperation, you will be able to lead your team to become stronger and win!

notes.title: Take you in-depth understanding of "Basketball Grand Slam 2024"
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2676770/Basketball_Grand_Slam_2024/
Question [1]: What type of game is it?
Answer: "Basketball Grand Slam 2024" is a cartoon 3V3 basketball real-time confrontation game that simplifies the complex rules of basketball games and allows you to experience the fun of basketball games.

Question [2]: What are the competition modes?
Answer: We provide a ranked match mode for matching and battle through the ranking system; we also provide an innovative lobby room mode, where you can freely join the room for real competition. In addition, entertainment game modes are provided: bullfighting, room opening, three-point shooting, regular 3V3 matching mode, etc.

Question [3]: What should I do if I can’t fully master the game operation skills?
Answer: The game provides a practice court mode, which provides a detailed explanation of various difficulties in the game, such as shooting, blocking, dunking, and breakthroughs. It can be experienced repeatedly to help you master the game operation skills as soon as possible.

Question [4]: ​​What are the characteristics of players of different professions?
Answer: "Basketball Grand Slam 2024" provides 5 professions. You can choose different professions to increase points according to your preferences or lineup.

[i] PF power forward: a violent dunk player, an inside bully, good at: violent dunks, rushing rebounds, and mid-range offense.
Center C: King of the penalty area, defender of the interior, good at: attacking at the basket, rebounding, defending at the basket, and blocking shots at the basket.
SF small forward: Dominates the court with his excellent mid-range scoring ability. He is good at: mid-range shooting, outside defense, and breaking through opponents.
SG Shooting Guard: Team scorer, mid-range shooting expert, three-point expert, good at: mid-range shooting, three-point shooting.
PG point guard: The organizer of the team's offense. He roams the game with excellent ball control ability. He is good at: ball control, passing, and three-point shooting. [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/af59dbba5031314fb6d2e347f8cfd4408d7f4930.png[/img]
Question [5]: How to obtain players?
Answer: [Melon], [Son of the Wind], and [Aaron] will be given by default during the novice induction period. Other players can collect them through daily tasks, operational activities, level gift packs, seven-day check-ins, rank rewards, etc.

Question [6]: How to improve players in the game?
Answer: "Basketball Grand Slam 2024" is a fair competitive basketball game. We only provide a small amount of attribute growth in [Skill Training] and the attributes of skill training can be worn by any player. The main growth of the game comes from player lineup matching and skills. Matching, skill training matching, operating skills.

Question [7]: What are the differences between different professional players, and the differences between different players in the same profession?
Answer: Players in different professions have different attributes and characteristics. For example, power forwards are good at blocking shots and rebounding; shooting guards are good at shooting. In addition, each player has his own unique talents and skills. You can check them and choose according to your preferences. At the same time, you can also quickly understand the preferences and strengths of each player through the "technical analysis" on the player interface.

Question [8]: How to obtain, match and trigger skills?
Answer: "Basketball Grand Slam 2024" skills are learned through level unlocking. Each player has different skills. The higher the level, the more skills can be unlocked. The highest skill can be equipped with 9 skills. Players can make reasonable combinations according to specific occupations. In addition, skills are triggered by probability.

notes.title: [Strategy and Defense] Practical defense skills
notes.content:
Hello, fellow players, we meet again! Previously, after the offensive chapter was completed, adhering to the concept of having more skills than being overwhelmed, today the editor has brought you a defensive chapter of our actual combat skills. Without further ado, come and take a look!

[b]【Marking】[/b]
In basketball games, marking refers to a defensive strategy in which a player closely tracks the opponent's offensive player to prevent the opponent from having a good scoring opportunity. When on the defensive side, players need to always observe the position and movements of the opponent's players, and take corresponding defensive measures immediately when they try to break through and score.
When the opponent player holds the ball, the player only needs to press and hold the marking button, and the player will automatically mark the opponent's player. Marking is mainly a defensive strategy that is not easily knocked down by the opponent, and successful marking can make the opponent's players enter the ball state.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/66f151505f4ede9d73c6129ec23511e16b6f61f6.png[/img][i] Marking is a relatively basic and suitable defensive method for novices. Players with higher rank and stronger defensive shooting ability can change the defensive method appropriately. [/i]

[b]【Steal】[/b]
Stealing is a common and important skill in basketball. It refers to an offensive method in which the defender obtains the ball by promptly snatching control of the opponent's player's possession of the ball. Sometimes a successful steal of ours can interrupt the opponent's offensive rhythm in a short period of time, giving the team a great advantage.
When the opponent player is holding the ball, the player needs to stand in the fan-shaped area directly in front of the opponent player. When the fan-shaped box appears green, he can then just press the steal button to steal. Among players, players in the SF, SG, and PG positions will have slightly higher steal attributes and correspondingly higher steal success rates. PG players can also bring fancy skills to steal from behind, unlocking the ability to steal the ball from behind the opponent.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/10410b8d1741dca80c2aba9466c3e17fa3b6bb76.png[/img][i]Don't steal easily. Once you take the shot, you may give your opponent an open shot or a breakthrough score. After successfully stealing the ball, pass the ball quickly to prevent the opponent from counterattacking. [/i]

[b]【Interception】[/b]
Interception refers to the defensive player using his or her body or arms to block the path of the opponent's passing or dribbling, intercepting the opponent's passing or receiving, and thus seizing the ball. The purpose of intercepting the ball is to influence the opponent's passing and offensive route through defensive positioning without direct contact with the opponent's players. It pays more attention to the player's position and cooperation. In the game, a successful interception can often change the situation of the game. .
Players should stand between the passer and the person being passed, so that there is a probability of triggering an interception. Players need to observe the movements of the passer and other players to judge the position of the person being passed. Note that successfully intercepting the ball will block the ball to the ground, and players need to quickly chase the intercepted ball.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/df5de53ac5ca2d6ea04fa2f26c6a1154cec78da4.png[/img][i] When the interception is successful, it is also easy to attract a large number of players to grab the ball. After getting the ball, try to pass the ball quickly and cooperate with teammates. [/i]

notes.title: "Basketball Grand Slam 2024" practical offensive skills-Part 3
notes.content:
[b][Three-point line] [/b]
In basketball, the three-point line is an arc-shaped line 6.75 meters away from the basket. This line marks the shooting range of the three-pointer. If a player takes a shot beyond this line and makes it, it counts as a three-pointer.
In the game, players can observe the field. The arc line on the outside of the basketball court is the three-point line. In addition, players can also observe the circle under their feet. When the circle displays dark blue, it is outside the three-point line. It needs to be reminded that the shooting rate will be very low if it is 0.5 meters beyond the three-point line. Players should control the shooting distance. The three-pointer is a powerful scoring weapon. Players try to create openings to shoot three-pointers, but do not blindly emphasize the three-pointer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/6e8a5322fb666ead9b9b93a63cfdb836fe611753.png[/img][i]In the game, it should be noted that the defender has stronger interference with three-pointers, so players cannot blindly try top shots. [/i]

[b]【All empty seats】[/b]
Fully open refers to a situation where there are no defensive players in an area of ​​the court during a game. This situation usually occurs when the defensive player makes a mistake or the defensive strategy fails. If a player can find an open space, he can use this opportunity to organize tactics or score points, greatly improving the team's offensive efficiency.
First of all, players need to read and understand the movement trajectory of the opponent's players, and create openings for their teammates by breaking through, pulling the ball back, or the defender making mistakes and passing the ball.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/ded5844274e47f14d9a3173a0d1bd4e318b1d9cf.png[/img][i]Always try to match up with your teammates and use simple but effective passing strategies with them. [/i]

[b]【Half vacant seat】[/b]
Compared with full space, half space refers to an area where the defensive player is farther away from the player when shooting, dribbling or passing, but is not completely out of the way. This area is usually some distance away from the defender, allowing players to use a variety of techniques, such as jump shots, pushing or shaking defenders, to score or pass.
Similar to being fully open, players need to understand and observe the open spaces on the court and the movements of defensive players. Breaking through, pulling the ball back, or passing the ball is the key to hitting the semi-open position.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/ded5844274e47f14d9a3173a0d1bd4e318b1d9cf.png[/img][i] Try to keep moving during the game and break through the defender as much as possible. You will be more likely to get into the open space. [/i]

notes.title: "Basketball Grand Slam 2024" Practical Offensive Skills Guide - Part 2
notes.content:
In the last issue, I introduced you to the first part of the actual offensive skills of "Basketball Grand Slam 2024". Today, the editor brings you the second part, come and learn!

[b]【Breaking through and knocking down】[/b]
Breakthroughs and knockdowns are very important skills in basketball. The key is to make the defender lose balance and find it difficult to keep up with his own pace to create opportunities and improve scoring efficiency.
First of all, the principle of breaking through and knocking down is that the movement direction of the breakthrough side and the defender is opposite, and the defender will have a high probability of being knocked down. Players need to observe the opponent's defensive patterns and press the break key + direction keys to pass at the appropriate time. They can use the passing skills in fancy skills to increase the chance of success. In addition, whether the defender falls to the ground depends on the defensive angle and the speed of the attacker's reverse sliding screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/3fd6491034722cd38427bbd22e7253da77691181.png[/img][i] Before breaking through, players can confuse their opponents by turning around continuously so that they cannot judge the direction of your breakthrough. [/i]

[b]【Dunk】[/b]
Dunk, also known as slam dunk, is a cool skill in the game. It can attract attention and boost morale. Players need to choose players with excellent dunking and jumping abilities.
Similar to the under-blue layup, a dunk also requires the player to get close to the basket. When the circle under the player's feet turns blue and is about 1-2 positions away from the basket, pull the direction button towards the basket and press the shooting button at the same time. That’s it. Depending on the player's position, different dunk actions will appear. With different fancy dunk skills, you can unlock more handsome dunk actions and increase the probability and distance of success.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/dddd259daca4a6e59ab15e25d2db294dc4f64d88.png[/img][i] Dunking is not a 100% triggered action, and players need to practice more on dunking distance and timing to increase the success rate. [/i]

[b]【Block】[/b]
Rebounds are very important in basketball games, and the key point of rebounding is mainly positioning. The closer to the ball landing point, the higher the chance of grabbing the rebound. The second is the timing of rebounding. When a player is stuck and is at a disadvantage in fighting for rebounds, using point balls can play a big role at this time.
First of all, splitting the ball is a rebounding skill that only C and PF can learn. The name is point rebounding. It needs to be triggered when grabbing rebounds. The chasing button will turn into a ball-splitting key. Players can press the ball-splitting button to quickly jump up and throw the ball into the air. The ball's landing point will be reset, and the player can perform 3 consecutive Sub-ball.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/c90825da11cadebdb9cc730d3f3886a2b860eb4c.png[/img][i]Usually suitable for winning the ball when our rebounding players are at a disadvantage, and the speed and width of the ball distribution are faster than rebounding. [/i]

notes.title: "Basketball Grand Slam 2024" practical offensive skills guide - Part 1
notes.content:
In "Basketball Grand Slam 2024", players need to use various skills and strategies to win the game. For some novice players, they may still be confused and unfamiliar with these skills and strategies. Below, the editor has specially compiled some introductions to offensive skills for everyone, so that everyone can score points like picking out the bag and picking out the tricks.

[b][Pick and roll][/b]
Everyone knows that in basketball games, our handsome breakthroughs and shots with the ball are often embarrassingly resolved by the opponent's fierce defense. At this time, we need our teammates to "pick and roll" to help us weaken or resolve the opponent's defense. Give us space to create output.
The pick-and-roll button will only appear when our teammate is holding the ball. The correct pick-and-roll can prevent the opponent's actions and create opportunities for teammates to break through or shoot. The wrong pick-and-roll will waste time and stand still.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/f64ec751e35bce1919d718674b4cee4548c29971.png[/img][i]Pick-and-roll players can observe the movement route of the ball-holding player and move to the movement route in advance to pick-and-roll. [/i]

[b][Fake shots and cheat jumps][/b]
In basketball, the fake shot is an important skill, often used to create scoring opportunities and confuse the defense. If done well, it can create a pass or breakout opportunity by allowing the defender to create space, or by jumping up and down to block his own shot.
When the player holds the ball, quickly tap the shooting button, and the player will immediately make a fake shot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/c5903318da450f372a0f7cf188d2d5d4c2248dbc.png[/img][i] After the fake shot, the ball will enter the ball state and it is easy for the opponent to steal the ball, so you should take action as soon as possible. [/i]

[b]【Laupup】[/b]
As one of the most important scoring methods in basketball, layups are usually found under the basket and scored against the opponent's defense. You need to pay attention to the timing and rhythm of layups in different scenarios, according to the opponent's defense and position, to avoid being blocked by the opponent.
First, the player needs to control the player to move as close to the basket as possible. At this time, the ring under the player's feet will turn light blue. Then pull the direction key toward the basket and press the shooting key at the same time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/faf4c6088b4536bf8a8d70e1d2361f2591835e0f.png[/img][i] Try to ensure that there are no opponents blocking or physical confrontation in the layup direction to increase the scoring rate. [/i]

notes.content:
The most wonderful season of the year has arrived! 🎄The real-time competitive game "BASKETBALL GRAND SLAM 2024" will soon meet with fans at the end of the year!

Fancy skills in basketball, such as fancy dribbling, fadeaway jumpers, backhand windmills, violent dunks, etc., can be used in battles to detonate the audience and allow players to enjoy endless fresh pleasure.

There are various ways to play in the game, including 1v1 bullfighting, 3v3, regular season, ranked matches, etc. You can also invite friends to play together and create rooms to learn from each other.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781719/b8a671ca4fbaf91ed55d57dccd622f3df89ef5b2.png[/img]

Thank you for your attention and support. We will polish our products carefully, and please look forward to the official launch of "BASKETBALL GRAND SLAM 2024"!
